name: Maria van Hossen
original_name: マリア＝ファン・ホッセン
source: The younger of the two van Hossen sisters. She is lovely and energetic. She loves her father Vincent and loves to cling to him all the time. She has called Teppei 'Onii-chan' since their first meeting because he is engaged to marry her elder sister Sylvia.[spoiler] She secretly loves Teppei and wants to bear his child.[/spoiler]
translation: The younger of the two van Hossen sisters. She is lovely and energetic. She loves her father Vincent and loves to cling to him all the time.
